name: Lucky
description: Things have a habit of working out for you, often at the last possible second.

name: Sickly
description: You spend more of your childhood in bed than out of it. Your body is frail, but you read a great deal.

name: Prodigy
description: You pick things up frighteningly fast. Adults talk about you when they think you can't hear.

name: Black sheep
description: From the start you never quite fit in with your family, and they make sure you know it.

name: Silver tongue
description: You could talk a cat out of a tree, and you talked your way out of trouble before you could ride a bike.

name: Iron constitution
description: You never catch colds, heal quickly, and once fell off a roof without a scratch.
